payload.name: Context-dependent birdsong structure
payload.fact: Collared flycatchers exhibit context-dependent changes in syllable sequence richness, with lower richness of short repeated sequences in the presence of an approaching female and higher richness of long repeated sequences during counter-singing.

provenance.title: Context-dependent organization of birdsong: experimental evidence from the collared flycatcher, Ficedula albicollis
provenance.quote_or_locus: We found lower richness of short repeated sequences and a smaller repertoire size in the context of an approaching female compared to the solo context. Conversely, we found higher richness of long repeated sequences and songs with more syllables in counter-singing compared to the solo context
